digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter consolidation and loader refactoring
propositions: Eight Jira root modules must be physically relocated into src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims left at old paths.
The loader must be taught relative subpaths for location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) without breaking dynamic loads of ~30 other root modules.

All surviving dotted and sibling-path references across ~29 locations (including jira_fields.py line 18, inbound_fields.py line 36, acli_cli_ops.py line 36, and test patches) must be atomically repointed to the new adapters.jira namespace.
The change is atomic: partial moves break file-location resolution, so all modules, loader updates, and reference rewrites must land together in one changeset with no intermediate state.
